A Hyundai-designed car, with the exact same color and design as the one in the input image, driving smoothly down a highway.
Regardless of the input car image, we create driving videos of cars that are "Hyundai-like" by reflecting the characteristics and design elements of Hyundai cars that are familiar to many.
The entire vehicle must be captured in the video.
If the distance to the vehicle image is too close, create the video with a viewpoint at an appropriate distance.
Perfect concatenation of one frame of the video and the input image.
When generating a video from an input image, the first frame is always uninterrupted and the video is smooth from beginning to end.
Be sure to add in the video to create the physical phenomenon and appearance of the wheels rolling while actually driving.

The video starts from the angle of the input image, but is generated to show driving on the highway without going at an angle and following actual traffic laws.
The generated videos are always created to show the vehicle driving along the road's driving lines.
Even the interior of the car (mainly the car seats) is made as detailed as the real thing.
The vehicle's appearance is made to show the entire body at a 4/3 angle from the front.
The highest priority is to ensure the generated car is an exact, identical, and precise match to the original design in the input image, preserving its form without any alterations.
(Physically-accurate forward rotation:1.2), with details like spokes and logos moving realistically within a natural motion blur while perfectly preserving their original intricate shape.
The car must driving forward.
The wheels roll realistically while maintaining their original shape and detail.
A smooth 3rd person tracking shot follows the car at a moderate distance, keeping the entire vehicle in frame.
Maintain the color and shape of the original input image from beginning to end of the video.
